betterquesting:10.desc:8:
An §6Encoded Pattern§f is a crafting recipe stored as an item. It's the fundamental data piece of AE2's §6autocrafting§f system without patterns, your network cannot craft anything automatically.

Encoded Patterns are created interactively in a §6Pattern Terminal§f: place a §6Blank Pattern§f in the slot, add output and input items, and the terminal encodes the recipe. There is no direct crafting recipe for an Encoded Pattern.

Three pattern types: §6crafting§f (3x3 grid), §6processing§f (machine interface), and §6stonecutting§f. Sneak-right-click to clear an encoded pattern back to blank.

§ePS:§f Blank Patterns cost 3 Iron Ingots + 1 Calculation Processor + 1 Certus Quartz Crystal. Keep spares in your ME Chest for on-demand pattern creation.
